Approved evidence

Deploy / Hive

org.hive

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. The retained supplier category is the explicit annotation and sourcing service in Schedule A. Model APIs and the customer-operated Arbiter platform have separate service definitions. Customer-requested tasks can involve annotation, categorization, tagging and labeling. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
